SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO  CREATE   PROCEDURE warroom.usp_AttentionQueue_Add  (      @ProjectId BIGINT,      @SubsystemCode NVARCHAR(255),      @AttentionReason NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL,      @AttentionCategory NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,      @Username NVARCHAR(255) = NULL  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;            IF @CurrentCount >= @MaxActiveItems          BEGIN              THROW 51000, 'Attention Queue capacity reached.', 1;          END;            IF EXISTS          (              SELECT 1              FROM warroom.OperationalAttentionQueue              WHERE ProjectId = @ProjectId                AND SubsystemCode = @SubsystemCode                AND IsActive = 1          )          BEGIN              THROW 51001, 'Subsystem is already in the Attention Queue.', 1;            DECLARE @QueueItemId BIGINT = SCOPE_IDENTITY();            INSERT INTO warroom.OperationalAttentionQueueHistory          (              QueueItemId,              ProjectId,              SubsystemCode,              ActionType,              OldRank,              NewRank,              NewReason,              ChangedBy          )          VALUES          (              @QueueItemId,              @ProjectId,              @SubsystemCode,              'ADD',              NULL,              @NewRank,              @AttentionReason,              @Username          ); AS Message;      END TRY      BEGIN CATCH          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK;            SELECT              CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Success,              NULL AS QueueItemId,              NULL AS QueueRank,              ERROR_MESSAGE() AS Message;      END CATCH  END;  GO

AS Message;                RETURN;          END;            UPDATE warroom.OperationalAttentionQueue          SET QueueRank = -1,              UpdatedBy = @Username,              UpdatedOn = SYSUTCDATETIME()          WHERE QueueItemId = @QueueItemId;            UPDATE warroom.OperationalAttentionQueue          SET QueueRank = @CurrentRank,              UpdatedBy = @Username,              UpdatedOn = SYSUTCDATETIME()          WHERE QueueItemId = @TargetQueueItemId;            UPDATE warroom.OperationalAttentionQueue          SET QueueRank = @TargetRank,              UpdatedBy = @Username,              UpdatedOn = SYSUTCDATETIME()          WHERE QueueItemId = @QueueItemId;            INSERT INTO warroom.OperationalAttentionQueueHistory          (              QueueItemId,              ProjectId,              SubsystemCode,              ActionType,              OldRank,              NewRank,              ChangedBy          )          VALUES          (              @QueueItemId,              @ProjectId,              @SubsystemCode,              CASE WHEN @Direction = 'UP' THEN 'MOVE_UP' ELSE 'MOVE_DOWN' END,              @CurrentRank,              @TargetRank,              @Username          );            COMMIT;            SELECT              CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success,              'Queue item moved.' SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO        CREATE   PROCEDURE [warroom].[usp_GetProjectPunchFilterCatalogs]  (      @ProjectId BIGINT  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PunchBase;        /* =====================================================         Base punches         Used only for catalogs that must depend on real punches:         - Subsystems         - Statuses         - Disciplines         - Subcontractors           Templates and Categories come from configuration,         not from real punches, so templates with 0 punches         are still available in the filters.      ===================================================== */      SELECT          p.ProjectId,          p.TemplateID,          p.CategoryCode,          p.Category,          p.StatusCode,          p.[Status],          p.Discipline,          p.SubcontractorId,            SubsystemCode =              COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(h.SubsystemCode)), ''), 'NO SUBSYSTEM'),            mc.DS_COMPANY,          mc.DS_SHORT_COMPANY      INTO #PunchBase      FROM dbo.wap_PunchPaged p      INNER JOIN warroom.PunchReportTemplateConfig cfg          ON cfg.ProjectId = p.ProjectId         AND cfg.TemplateId = p.TemplateID         AND cfg.IsActive = 1         AND cfg.IsIncluded = 1      INNER JOIN dbo.wap_ElementHierarchyPunchView h          ON h.ProjectId = p.ProjectId         AND h.PunchId = p.Id      LEFT JOIN dbo.DIM_MASTER_COMPANIES_LH mc          ON mc.ID_COMPANY = TRY_CONVERT(INT, p.SubcontractorId)      WHERE p.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.StatusCode)), '') IS NOT NULL        AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.StatusCode))) NOT IN ('HOLD', 'VOID');        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_PunchBase_Filters      ON #PunchBase(TemplateID, CategoryCode, StatusCode, Discipline, SubsystemCode);        /* =====================================================         Table1 - Subsystems      ===================================================== */      SELECT DISTINCT          Code = SubsystemCode,          Label =              CASE                  WHEN SubsystemCode = 'NO SUBSYSTEM'                      THEN 'NO SUBSYSTEM - Unassigned punches'                  ELSE SubsystemCode              END,          SortOrder =              CASE                  WHEN SubsystemCode = 'NO SUBSYSTEM' THEN 999999                  ELSE 1              END      FROM #PunchBase      ORDER BY          SortOrder,          Code;        /* =====================================================         Table2 - Templates         Source: PunchReportTemplateConfig         Important: include templates even if they have 0 punches.      ===================================================== */      SELECT DISTINCT          TemplateId = TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, cfg.TemplateId),          TemplateCode = CAST(t.Code AS NVARCHAR(50)),          TemplateLabel =              CAST(                  CONCAT(                      COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.Code)), ''), 'TPL'),                      ' - ',                      COALESCE(                          NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.Description)), ''),                          CONCAT('Template ', cfg.TemplateId)                      )                  ) AS NVARCHAR(255)              ),          TemplateDescription = CAST(t.Description AS NVARCHAR(255)),          SortOrder = ISNULL(cfg.DisplayOrder, 999)      FROM warroom.PunchReportTemplateConfig cfg      LEFT JOIN dbo.wap_Template t          ON t.Id = cfg.TemplateId      WHERE cfg.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND cfg.IsActive = 1        AND cfg.IsIncluded = 1      ORDER BY          SortOrder,          TemplateLabel;        /* =====================================================         Table3 - Categories         Source: PunchReportTemplateConfig + wap_Category         Important: include configured template categories even         if there are 0 punches in that category.      ===================================================== */      SELECT DISTINCT          TemplateId = TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, cfg.TemplateId),          CategoryCode = CAST(c.Code AS NVARCHAR(50)),          CategoryLabel =              CAST(                  COALESCE(                      NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.Description)), ''),                      NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.Code)), ''),                      'Uncategorized'                  ) AS NVARCHAR(255)              ),          DisplayLabel =              CAST(                  CONCAT(                      COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.Code)), ''), 'N/A'),                      ' - ',                      COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.Description)), ''), 'Uncategorized')                  ) AS NVARCHAR(255)              ),          SortOrder = ISNULL(c.[Order], 999)      FROM warroom.PunchReportTemplateConfig cfg      INNER JOIN dbo.wap_Category c          ON c.TemplateId = cfg.TemplateId         AND c.IsActive = 1      WHERE cfg.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND cfg.IsActive = 1        AND cfg.IsIncluded = 1        AND c.Code IS NOT NULL      ORDER BY          TemplateId,          SortOrder,          CategoryCode;        /* =====================================================         Table4 - Statuses         Source: project status config if available.         Fallback: statuses detected in punches.      ===================================================== */      IF EXISTS      (          SELECT 1          FROM warroom.PunchReportStatusConfig sc          WHERE sc.ProjectId = @ProjectId            AND sc.IsActive = 1            AND sc.IsIncluded = 1      )      BEGIN          SELECT DISTINCT              StatusCode = CAST(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(sc.StatusCode))) AS NVARCHAR(50)),              StatusLabel = CAST(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(sc.StatusCode))) AS NVARCHAR(50)),              SortOrder = ISNULL(sc.DisplayOrder, 999)          FROM warroom.PunchReportStatusConfig sc          WHERE sc.ProjectId = @ProjectId            AND sc.IsActive = 1            AND sc.IsIncluded = 1            AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(sc.StatusCode)), '') IS NOT NULL            AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(sc.StatusCode))) NOT IN ('HOLD', 'VOID')          ORDER BY              SortOrder,              StatusCode;      END      ELSE      BEGIN          SELECT DISTINCT              StatusCode = CAST(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(StatusCode))) AS NVARCHAR(50)),              StatusLabel = CAST(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(StatusCode))) AS NVARCHAR(50)),              SortOrder =                  CASE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(StatusCode)))                      WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 1                      WHEN 'EXECUTED' THEN 2                      WHEN 'CLEARED' THEN 3                      WHEN 'VALIDATED' THEN 4                      WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 5                      ELSE 999                  END          FROM #PunchBase          WHERE StatusCode IS NOT NULL            AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(StatusCode))) NOT IN ('HOLD', 'VOID')          ORDER BY              SortOrder,              StatusCode;      END;        /* =====================================================         Table5 - Disciplines      ===================================================== */      SELECT DISTINCT          Discipline = CAST(Discipline AS NVARCHAR(100)),          DisciplineLabel = CAST(Discipline AS NVARCHAR(100))      FROM #PunchBase      WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(Discipline)), '') IS NOT NULL      ORDER BY          Discipline;        /* =====================================================         Table6 - Subcontractors      ===================================================== */      SELECT DISTINCT          SubcontractorId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, SubcontractorId),          SubcontractorCode = CAST(TRY_CONVERT(INT, SubcontractorId) AS NVARCHAR(50)),          SubcontractorName =              CAST(                  COALESCE(                      NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(DS_SHORT_COMPANY)), ''),                      NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(DS_COMPANY)), ''),                      CONCAT('Company ', TRY_CONVERT(INT, SubcontractorId))                  ) AS NVARCHAR(255)              ),          SubcontractorFullName = CAST(DS_COMPANY AS NVARCHAR(255))      FROM #PunchBase      WHERE SubcontractorId IS NOT NULL        AND TRY_CONVERT(INT, SubcontractorId) IS NOT NULL      ORDER BY          SubcontractorName;  END    GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO        CREATE   PROCEDURE warroom.usp_GetPulseSubsystemSkyline  (      @ProjectId BIGINT,      @FromDate DATE = NULL,      @ToDate DATE = NULL,      @PunchWeight INT = 3  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;        SET @FromDate = ISNULL(@FromDate, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));      SET @ToDate = ISNULL(@ToDate, DATEADD(WEEK, 12, @FromDate));        IF @PunchWeight IS NULL OR @PunchWeight < 1          SET @PunchWeight = 3;        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Elements;        CREATE TABLE #Elements      (          ELEMENT_ID INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,          ELEMENT_CODE NVARCHAR(255) NULL,          SUBSYSTEM_CODE NVARCHAR(255) NULL,          ElementDisciplineName NVARCHAR(255) NULL      );        INSERT INTO #Elements      SELECT          e.ELEMENT_ID,          e.ELEMENT_CODE,          e.SUBSYSTEM_CODE,          e.ElementDisciplineName      FROM dbo.getProjectElementsDefault_extended(@ProjectId) e      WHERE e.SUBSYSTEM_CODE IS NOT NULL;        CREATE INDEX IX_Elements_Subsystem ON #Elements(SUBSYSTEM_CODE);      CREATE INDEX IX_Elements_ElementCode ON #Elements(ELEMENT_CODE);        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TaskAgg;        SELECT          e.SUBSYSTEM_CODE AS SubsystemCode,          COUNT(1) AS OpenTasks      INTO #TaskAgg      FROM dbo.InspectionTasks t      INNER JOIN #Elements e          ON e.ELEMENT_ID = t.ElementId      LEFT JOIN dbo.TaskStatus ts          ON ts.Id = t.[Status]      WHERE          t.ProjectId = @ProjectId          AND t.Active = 1          AND ISNULL(ts.StatusName, '') NOT IN ('Done', 'Closed', 'Completed')      GROUP BY          e.SUBSYSTEM_CODE;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TaskAgg_Subsystem      ON #TaskAgg(SubsystemCode);        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PunchAgg;        SELECT          e.SUBSYSTEM_CODE AS SubsystemCode,          COUNT(1) AS OpenPunches      INTO #PunchAgg      FROM dbo.getProjectPunchPaged(@ProjectId) p      INNER JOIN #Elements e          ON e.ELEMENT_CODE = p.Items      WHERE          NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.StatusCode)), '') IS NOT NULL          AND ISNULL(p.[Status], '') NOT IN ('Closed', 'Completed', 'Cancelled')      GROUP BY          e.SUBSYSTEM_CODE;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_PunchAgg_Subsystem      ON #PunchAgg(SubsystemCode);        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Skyline;        SELECT          m.Id,          m.ProjectId,          m.SubsystemCode,          m.PlannedDate,          m.ForecastDate,          m.ActualDate,          COALESCE(m.ForecastDate, m.PlannedDate) AS SkylineDate,            DATEADD(              DAY,              (7 - DATEPART(WEEKDAY, COALESCE(m.ForecastDate, m.PlannedDate)) + @@DATEFIRST) % 7,              COALESCE(m.ForecastDate, m.PlannedDate)          ) AS WeekEnding,            ISNULL(t.OpenTasks, 0) AS OpenTasks,          ISNULL(p.OpenPunches, 0) AS OpenPunches,          ISNULL(t.OpenTasks, 0) + (ISNULL(p.OpenPunches, 0) * @PunchWeight) AS WorkloadScore,            CASE              WHEN COALESCE(m.ForecastDate, m.PlannedDate) IS NULL THEN NULL              ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), COALESCE(m.ForecastDate, m.PlannedDate))          END AS DaysRemaining,            m.Notes      INTO #Skyline      FROM warroom.SubsystemMilestone m      LEFT JOIN #TaskAgg t          ON t.SubsystemCode = m.SubsystemCode      LEFT JOIN #PunchAgg p          ON p.SubsystemCode = m.SubsystemCode      WHERE          m.ProjectId = @ProjectId          AND (              COALESCE(m.ForecastDate, m.PlannedDate) IS NULL              OR COALESCE(m.ForecastDate, m.PlannedDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate          );        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Skyline_Order      ON #Skyline(WeekEnding, SubsystemCode);        SELECT          Id,          ProjectId,          SubsystemCode,          PlannedDate,          ForecastDate,          ActualDate,          SkylineDate,          WeekEnding,          OpenTasks,          OpenPunches,          WorkloadScore,          DaysRemaining,            CASE              WHEN ActualDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Delivered'              WHEN SkylineDate IS NULL THEN 'No Date'              WHEN SkylineDate < CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) THEN 'Overdue'              WHEN DaysRemaining <= 14                   AND (OpenTasks > 0 OR OpenPunches > 0)                   THEN 'Critical'              WHEN DaysRemaining <= 30                   AND (OpenTasks > 0 OR OpenPunches > 0)                   THEN 'At Risk'              WHEN OpenPunches > 0 THEN 'Attention'              ELSE 'On Track'          END AS RiskStatus,            CASE              WHEN ActualDate IS NOT NULL THEN 100              WHEN SkylineDate IS NULL THEN 0              WHEN SkylineDate < CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) THEN 20              WHEN OpenTasks = 0 AND OpenPunches = 0 THEN 95              WHEN DaysRemaining <= 14 THEN 35              WHEN DaysRemaining <= 30 THEN 55              ELSE 75          END AS ReadinessScore,            Notes,          @PunchWeight AS PunchWeight        FROM #Skyline      ORDER BY          WeekEnding,          SubsystemCode;  END;    GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO    CREATE PROCEDURE [warroom].[usp_InspectionScope_GroupedTotals]  (      @ProjectId   BIGINT,      @OnlyActive  BIT = 1  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;        ------------------------------------------------------------      -- A) STAGE TaskMatrices (mínimo)      ------------------------------------------------------------      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TM') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TM;        SELECT          tm.Id,          tm.ProjectId,          tm.ElementTypeId,          tm.FormId,          tm.MasterTask,          tm.Description,          tm.DisciplineId,          tm.Sct,          tm.ElementId      INTO #TM      FROM dbo.TaskMatrices tm      WHERE tm.ProjectId = @ProjectId;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TM_Id ON #TM(Id);      CREATE INDEX IX_TM_ElementId ON #TM(ElementId) WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;      CREATE INDEX IX_TM_FormId ON #TM(FormId) WHERE FormId IS NOT NULL;        ------------------------------------------------------------      -- B) NeedE + Elements (solo necesarios)      ------------------------------------------------------------      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NeedE') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NeedE;        SELECT DISTINCT ElementId      INTO #NeedE      FROM #TM      WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedE ON #NeedE(ElementId);        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#E') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #E;        SELECT          e.Id                  AS ELEMENT_ID,          e.TypeId              AS ElementTypeId,          nl.Name               AS LevelName,          CAST(e.Active AS bit) AS Active      INTO #E      FROM dbo.Elements e      INNER JOIN #NeedE ne          ON ne.ElementId = e.Id      LEFT JOIN dbo.NodeLevels nl          ON nl.Id = e.NodeLevelId      WHERE e.ProjectId = @ProjectId;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_E_EID ON #E(ELEMENT_ID);      CREATE INDEX IX_E_TypeId ON #E(ElementTypeId) WHERE ElementTypeId IS NOT NULL;        ------------------------------------------------------------      -- C) NeedF + Forms      ------------------------------------------------------------      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NeedF') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NeedF;        SELECT DISTINCT FormId      INTO #NeedF      FROM #TM      WHERE FormId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedF_FormId ON #NeedF(FormId);        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#F') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #F;        SELECT          f.Id          AS FormId,          f.ProjectId,          f.Name        AS FormName,          f.Description AS FormDescription,          f.PhaseId      INTO #F      FROM dbo.Forms f      INNER JOIN #NeedF nf          ON nf.FormId = f.Id      WHERE f.ProjectId = @ProjectId;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_F_FormId ON #F(FormId);      CREATE INDEX IX_F_PhaseId ON #F(PhaseId) WHERE PhaseId IS NOT NULL;        ------------------------------------------------------------      -- D) NeedP + Phases      ------------------------------------------------------------      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NeedP') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NeedP;        SELECT DISTINCT PhaseId      INTO #NeedP      FROM #F      WHERE PhaseId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedP_PhaseId ON #NeedP(PhaseId);        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#P') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #P;        SELECT          p.Id   AS PhaseId,          p.Name AS PhaseName      INTO #P      FROM dbo.Phases p      INNER JOIN #NeedP np          ON np.PhaseId = p.Id;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_P_PhaseId ON #P(PhaseId);        ------------------------------------------------------------      -- E) Matrices enriched (#M)      ------------------------------------------------------------      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#M') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #M;        SELECT          tm.Id,            ElementDiscipline =              COALESCE(d_e.Name, d_tm.Name),            ElementLevel =              COALESCE(e.LevelName, nl_tm.Name),            PhaseName = p.PhaseName,          f.FormName,          f.FormDescription,            tm.Sct,          tm.MasterTask,            ResolutionSource =              CASE                  WHEN tm.ElementId IS NOT NULL AND e.ELEMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ELEMENT'                  ELSE 'MATRIX'              END,            tm.ElementId      INTO #M      FROM #TM tm      LEFT JOIN #F f          ON f.FormId = tm.FormId      LEFT JOIN #P p          ON p.PhaseId = f.PhaseId        LEFT JOIN #E e          ON e.ELEMENT_ID = tm.ElementId      LEFT JOIN dbo.ElementTypes et_e          ON et_e.Id = e.ElementTypeId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Disciplines d_e          ON d_e.Id = et_e.DisciplineId        LEFT JOIN dbo.ElementTypes et_tm          ON et_tm.Id = tm.ElementTypeId      LEFT JOIN dbo.NodeLevels nl_tm          ON nl_tm.Id = et_tm.NodeLevelId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Disciplines d_tm          ON d_tm.Id = tm.DisciplineId      WHERE          (tm.ElementId IS NULL OR e.Active = 1);        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_M_Id ON #M(Id);      CREATE INDEX IX_M_RS_Id ON #M(ResolutionSource, Id);      CREATE INDEX IX_M_ElementId_RS ON #M(ElementId, ResolutionSource) WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        ------------------------------------------------------------      -- F) InspectionTasks      ------------------------------------------------------------      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#IT') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IT;        SELECT          it.Id,          it.TaskMatrixItemId,          it.ElementId,          CAST(it.Active AS bit) AS Active,          it.Status,          it.ProjectId      INTO #IT      FROM dbo.InspectionTasks it      WHERE          it.ProjectId = @ProjectId          AND (@OnlyActive = 0 OR it.Active = 1);        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_IT_Id ON #IT(Id);      CREATE INDEX IX_IT_TaskMatrixItemId ON #IT(TaskMatrixItemId) WHERE TaskMatrixItemId IS NOT NULL;      CREATE INDEX IX_IT_ElementId ON #IT(ElementId) WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT          it.Id AS InspectionTaskId,            m.ElementDiscipline,          m.ElementLevel,          m.PhaseName,          m.FormName,          m.FormDescription,          m.Sct,          m.MasterTask          INTO #Base      FROM #IT it      INNER JOIN #M m          ON it.TaskMatrixItemId IS NOT NULL         AND it.TaskMatrixItemId = m.Id         AND (              m.ResolutionSource = 'MATRIX'              OR (m.ResolutionSource = 'ELEMENT' AND it.ElementId = m.ElementId)         );        CREATE INDEX IX_Base_Group          ON #Base(ElementDiscipline, ElementLevel, PhaseName, FormName, FormDescription, Sct, MasterTask);        ------------------------------------------------------------      -- H) Agrupación final + GroupKey estable + Total      ------------------------------------------------------------      SELECT          GroupKey =              CONVERT(CHAR(64),                  HASHBYTES('SHA2_256',                      CONCAT(                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(ElementDiscipline, '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(ElementLevel,      '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(PhaseName,         '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(FormName,          '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(FormDescription,   '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(Sct         AS VARCHAR(20)), '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(MasterTask  AS VARCHAR(20)), ''))))                      )                  ), 2              ),            ElementDiscipline,          ElementLevel,          PhaseName,          FormName,          FormDescription,          Sct,          MasterTask,            TotalInspections = COUNT_BIG(1)      FROM #Base      GROUP BY          ElementDiscipline,          ElementLevel,          PhaseName,          FormName,          FormDescription,          Sct,          MasterTask        ORDER BY          ElementDiscipline,          ElementLevel,          PhaseName,          FormName,          Sct,          MasterTask;  END    GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO        CREATE   PROCEDURE warroom.usp_Operations_RefreshCellCache  (      @ProjectId BIGINT,      @SubsystemCode NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,      @OnlyActive BIT = 1  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;      SET XACT_ABORT ON;        DECLARE @Sub NVARCHAR(255) = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SubsystemCode)), '');        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TargetSubsystems;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #SubsystemElements;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ITScope;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #NeedTM;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TM;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #NeedE;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #E;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #NeedF;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #F;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #NeedP;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #P;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #M;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MResolved;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TaskResolved;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Agg;        CREATE TABLE #TargetSubsystems      (          SubsystemCode NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY      );        IF @Sub IS NULL      BEGIN          INSERT INTO #TargetSubsystems(SubsystemCode)          SELECT DISTINCT ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE          FROM dbo.Elements_Default ed          WHERE ed.ProjectId = @ProjectId            AND ed.LevelName = 'Subsystem'            AND ed.Active = 1            AND ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE IS NOT NULL;      END      ELSE      BEGIN          INSERT INTO #TargetSubsystems(SubsystemCode)          VALUES (@Sub);      END;        CREATE TABLE #SubsystemElements      (          ElementId INT NOT NULL,          SubsystemCode NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL      );        INSERT INTO #SubsystemElements(ElementId, SubsystemCode)      SELECT          ed.ELEMENT_ID,          ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE      FROM dbo.Elements_Default ed      INNER JOIN #TargetSubsystems s          ON s.SubsystemCode = ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE      WHERE ed.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND ed.Active = 1        AND ed.ELEMENT_ID IS NOT NULL        AND ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE IS NOT NULL;        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_SubsystemElements_ElementId          ON #SubsystemElements(ElementId);        CREATE INDEX IX_SubsystemElements_SubsystemCode          ON #SubsystemElements(SubsystemCode);        CREATE TABLE #ITScope      (          InspectionTaskId INT NOT NULL,          SubsystemCode NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,          TaskMatrixItemId INT NOT NULL,          ElementId INT NULL,          StatusVal INT NULL      );        INSERT INTO #ITScope      (          InspectionTaskId,          SubsystemCode,          TaskMatrixItemId,          ElementId,          StatusVal      )      SELECT          it.Id,          se.SubsystemCode,          it.TaskMatrixItemId,          it.ElementId,          it.[Status]      FROM dbo.InspectionTasks it      INNER JOIN #SubsystemElements se          ON se.ElementId = it.ElementId      WHERE it.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND (@OnlyActive = 0 OR it.Active = 1)        AND it.TaskMatrixItemId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ITScope_TaskId          ON #ITScope(InspectionTaskId);        CREATE INDEX IX_ITScope_TaskMatrixItemId          ON #ITScope(TaskMatrixItemId);        CREATE INDEX IX_ITScope_ElementId          ON #ITScope(ElementId)          WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT DISTINCT TaskMatrixItemId      INTO #NeedTM      FROM #ITScope;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedTM_TaskMatrixItemId          ON #NeedTM(TaskMatrixItemId);        SELECT          tm.Id,          tm.ProjectId,          tm.ElementTypeId,          tm.FormId,          tm.MasterTask,          tm.Description,          tm.DisciplineId,          tm.Sct,          tm.ElementId      INTO #TM      FROM dbo.TaskMatrices tm      INNER JOIN #NeedTM ntm          ON ntm.TaskMatrixItemId = tm.Id      WHERE tm.ProjectId = @ProjectId;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TM_Id          ON #TM(Id);        CREATE INDEX IX_TM_ElementId          ON #TM(ElementId)          WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE INDEX IX_TM_FormId          ON #TM(FormId)          WHERE FormId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT DISTINCT ElementId      INTO #NeedE      FROM #TM      WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedE_ElementId          ON #NeedE(ElementId);        SELECT          e.Id AS ELEMENT_ID,          e.TypeId AS ElementTypeId,          nl.Name AS LevelName,          CAST(e.Active AS BIT) AS Active      INTO #E      FROM dbo.Elements e      INNER JOIN #NeedE ne          ON ne.ElementId = e.Id      LEFT JOIN dbo.NodeLevels nl          ON nl.Id = e.NodeLevelId      WHERE e.ProjectId = @ProjectId;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_E_EID          ON #E(ELEMENT_ID);        CREATE INDEX IX_E_TypeId          ON #E(ElementTypeId)          WHERE ElementTypeId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT DISTINCT FormId      INTO #NeedF      FROM #TM      WHERE FormId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedF_FormId          ON #NeedF(FormId);        SELECT          f.Id AS FormId,          f.ProjectId,          f.Name AS FormName,          f.Description AS FormDescription,          f.PhaseId      INTO #F      FROM dbo.Forms f      INNER JOIN #NeedF nf          ON nf.FormId = f.Id      WHERE f.ProjectId = @ProjectId;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_F_FormId          ON #F(FormId);        CREATE INDEX IX_F_PhaseId          ON #F(PhaseId)          WHERE PhaseId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT DISTINCT PhaseId      INTO #NeedP      FROM #F      WHERE PhaseId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedP_PhaseId          ON #NeedP(PhaseId);        SELECT          p.Id AS PhaseId,          p.Name AS PhaseName      INTO #P      FROM dbo.Phases p      INNER JOIN #NeedP np          ON np.PhaseId = p.Id;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_P_PhaseId          ON #P(PhaseId);        SELECT          tm.Id,            ResolutionSource =              CASE                  WHEN tm.ElementId IS NOT NULL AND e.ELEMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ELEMENT'                  ELSE 'MATRIX'              END,            tm.ElementId,            GroupKey =              CONVERT(CHAR(64),                  HASHBYTES('SHA2_256',                      CONCAT(                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(COALESCE(d_e.Name, d_tm.Name), '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(COALESCE(e.LevelName, nl_tm.Name), '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(p.PhaseName, '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(f.FormName, '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(f.FormDescription, '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(tm.Sct AS VARCHAR(20)), '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(tm.MasterTask AS VARCHAR(20)), ''))))                      )                  ), 2              )      INTO #M      FROM #TM tm      LEFT JOIN #F f          ON f.FormId = tm.FormId      LEFT JOIN #P p          ON p.PhaseId = f.PhaseId      LEFT JOIN #E e          ON e.ELEMENT_ID = tm.ElementId      LEFT JOIN dbo.ElementTypes et_e          ON et_e.Id = e.ElementTypeId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Disciplines d_e          ON d_e.Id = et_e.DisciplineId      LEFT JOIN dbo.ElementTypes et_tm          ON et_tm.Id = tm.ElementTypeId      LEFT JOIN dbo.NodeLevels nl_tm          ON nl_tm.Id = et_tm.NodeLevelId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Disciplines d_tm          ON d_tm.Id = tm.DisciplineId      WHERE tm.ElementId IS NULL         OR e.Active = 1;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_M_Id          ON #M(Id);        CREATE INDEX IX_M_GroupKey          ON #M(GroupKey);        SELECT          m.Id,          m.ResolutionSource,          m.ElementId,            n1.NodeId AS L1NodeId,          n1.DisplayName AS L1DisplayName,          n1.SortOrder AS L1SortOrder,            n2.NodeId AS L2NodeId,          n2.DisplayName AS L2DisplayName,          n2.SortOrder AS L2SortOrder,            n3.NodeId AS L3NodeId,          n3.DisplayName AS L3DisplayName,          n3.SortOrder AS L3SortOrder      INTO #MResolved      FROM #M m      INNER JOIN warroom.ReportAssignment ra          ON ra.ProjectId = @ProjectId         AND ra.GroupKey = m.GroupKey      INNER JOIN warroom.ReportNode n3          ON n3.NodeId = ra.NodeId         AND n3.ProjectId = @ProjectId         AND n3.LevelNo = 3         AND n3.IsActive = 1      INNER JOIN warroom.ReportNode n2          ON n2.NodeId = n3.ParentNodeId         AND n2.ProjectId = @ProjectId         AND n2.LevelNo = 2         AND n2.IsActive = 1      INNER JOIN warroom.ReportNode n1          ON n1.NodeId = n2.ParentNodeId         AND n1.ProjectId = @ProjectId         AND n1.LevelNo = 1         AND n1.IsActive = 1;        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_MResolved_Id          ON #MResolved(Id);        SELECT          it.InspectionTaskId,          it.SubsystemCode,          it.StatusVal,            mr.L1NodeId,          mr.L1DisplayName,          mr.L1SortOrder,            mr.L2NodeId,          mr.L2DisplayName,          mr.L2SortOrder,            mr.L3NodeId,          mr.L3DisplayName,          mr.L3SortOrder      INTO #TaskResolved      FROM #ITScope it      INNER JOIN #MResolved mr          ON mr.Id = it.TaskMatrixItemId         AND         (              mr.ResolutionSource = 'MATRIX'              OR              (                  mr.ResolutionSource = 'ELEMENT'                  AND mr.ElementId = it.ElementId              )         );        SELECT          ProjectId = @ProjectId,          SubsystemCode = tr.SubsystemCode,            tr.L1NodeId,          tr.L2NodeId,          tr.L3NodeId,            L1DisplayName = MAX(tr.L1DisplayName),          L2DisplayName = MAX(tr.L2DisplayName),          L3DisplayName = MAX(tr.L3DisplayName),            TotalTasks = CONVERT(INT, COUNT_BIG(1)),          DoneTasks = CONVERT(INT, SUM(CASE WHEN tr.StatusVal = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),          RemainingTasks = CONVERT(INT, SUM(CASE WHEN tr.StatusVal <> 5 OR tr.StatusVal IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),            ProgressPercent =              CAST(                  CASE                      WHEN COUNT_BIG(1) = 0 THEN 0                      ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN tr.StatusVal = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT_BIG(1), 0)                  END              AS DECIMAL(10,2))      INTO #Agg      FROM #TaskResolved tr      GROUP BY          tr.SubsystemCode,          tr.L1NodeId,          tr.L2NodeId,          tr.L3NodeId;        MERGE warroom.OperationalCellCache AS tgt      USING #Agg AS src          ON tgt.ProjectId = src.ProjectId         AND tgt.SubsystemCode = src.SubsystemCode         AND tgt.L3NodeId = src.L3NodeId      WHEN MATCHED THEN          UPDATE SET              tgt.L1NodeId = src.L1NodeId,              tgt.L2NodeId = src.L2NodeId,              tgt.L1DisplayName = src.L1DisplayName,              tgt.L2DisplayName = src.L2DisplayName,              tgt.L3DisplayName = src.L3DisplayName,              tgt.TotalTasks = src.TotalTasks,              tgt.DoneTasks = src.DoneTasks,              tgt.RemainingTasks = src.RemainingTasks,              tgt.ProgressPercent = src.ProgressPercent,              tgt.RefreshedOn = SYSUTCDATETIME()      WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN          INSERT          (              ProjectId,              SubsystemCode,              L1NodeId,              L2NodeId,              L3NodeId,              L1DisplayName,              L2DisplayName,              L3DisplayName,              TotalTasks,              DoneTasks,              RemainingTasks,              ProgressPercent,              RefreshedOn          )          VALUES          (              src.ProjectId,              src.SubsystemCode,              src.L1NodeId,              src.L2NodeId,              src.L3NodeId,              src.L1DisplayName,              src.L2DisplayName,              src.L3DisplayName,              src.TotalTasks,              src.DoneTasks,              src.RemainingTasks,              src.ProgressPercent,              SYSUTCDATETIME()          );        DELETE c      FROM warroom.OperationalCellCache c      WHERE c.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND (@Sub IS NULL OR c.SubsystemCode = @Sub)        AND NOT EXISTS        (            SELECT 1            FROM #Agg a            WHERE a.ProjectId = c.ProjectId              AND a.SubsystemCode = c.SubsystemCode              AND a.L3NodeId = c.L3NodeId        );        SELECT          CachedCells = COUNT(*)      FROM warroom.OperationalCellCache      WHERE ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND (@Sub IS NULL OR SubsystemCode = @Sub);  END;    GO

TotalCount Subsistemas      -------------------------------------------------------------------        DECLARE @TotalCount INT;        ;WITH S AS      (          SELECT DISTINCT SubsystemCode = CAST(ProjectElement AS NVARCHAR(50))          FROM #Out          WHERE (@Search IS NULL OR ProjectElement LIKE '%' + @Search + '%')      )      SELECT @TotalCount = COUNT(1) FROM S;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 3. REGISTRAR SNAPSHOT DE EXPORTACI�N     ========================================================================== */    CREATE   PROCEDURE [warroom].[usp_RegisterPunchExportSnapshot]      @PunchExportLogId    bigint,      @ProjectId           bigint,      @TemplateId          bigint,      @ExportType          nvarchar(30),      @CreatedBy           nvarchar(320),      @FileName            nvarchar(260),      @AllowedColumnsJson  nvarchar(max),      @RowsJson            nvarchar(max),      @ExpiresAtUtc        datetime2(3) = NULL  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;      SET XACT_ABORT ON;        BEGIN TRY          /* ------------------------------------------------------------------             1. Validaci�n de par�metros             ------------------------------------------------------------------ */            IF @PunchExportLogId IS NULL OR @PunchExportLogId <= 0              THROW 51000, 'PunchExportLogId must be a positive integer.', 1;            IF @ProjectId IS NULL OR @ProjectId <= 0              THROW 51001, 'ProjectId must be a positive integer.', 1;            IF @TemplateId IS NULL OR @TemplateId < 0              THROW 51002, 'TemplateId cannot be null or negative.', 1;            SET @ExportType =              NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ExportType)), N'');            SET @CreatedBy =              NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CreatedBy)), N'');            SET @FileName =              NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@FileName)), N'');            IF @ExportType IS NULL              THROW 51003, 'ExportType is required.', 1;            IF @CreatedBy IS NULL              THROW 51004, 'CreatedBy is required.', 1;            IF @FileName IS NULL              THROW 51005, 'FileName is required.', 1;            IF ISJSON(@AllowedColumnsJson) <> 1             OR LEFT(LTRIM(@AllowedColumnsJson), 1) <> N'['              THROW 51006, 'AllowedColumnsJson must be a JSON array.', 1;            IF ISJSON(@RowsJson) <> 1             OR LEFT(LTRIM(@RowsJson), 1) <> N'['              THROW 51007, 'RowsJson must be a JSON array.', 1;            /* ------------------------------------------------------------------             2. Carga inicial permisiva               WorkItemId se permite NULL temporalmente para poder devolver             errores funcionales controlados en vez de errores de inserci�n.             ------------------------------------------------------------------ */            DECLARE @RowsStage TABLE          (              SourceOrdinal       int             NOT NULL,              WorkItemId          bigint          NULL,              SourceProjectId     bigint          NULL,              SourceExportLogId   bigint          NULL,              RowChecksum         varchar(64)     NULL,              OriginalValuesJson  nvarchar(max)   NULL          );            INSERT INTO @RowsStage          (              SourceOrdinal,              WorkItemId,              SourceProjectId,              SourceExportLogId,              RowChecksum,              OriginalValuesJson          )          SELECT              SourceOrdinal =                  TRY_CONVERT(int, src.[key]),                WorkItemId =                  TRY_CONVERT                  (                      bigint,                      JSON_VALUE(src.[value], '$.PunchId')                  ),                SourceProjectId =                  TRY_CONVERT                  (                      bigint,                      JSON_VALUE(src.[value], '$.ProjectId')                  ),                SourceExportLogId =                  TRY_CONVERT                  (                      bigint,                      JSON_VALUE(src.[value], '$.PunchExportLogId')                  ),                RowChecksum =                  UPPER                  (                      NULLIF                      (                          LTRIM                          (                              RTRIM                              (                                  CONVERT                                  (                                      varchar(64),                                      JSON_VALUE(src.[value], '$.RowHash')                                  )                              )                          ),                          ''                      )                  ),                OriginalValuesJson =                  COALESCE                  (                      JSON_QUERY                      (                          src.[value],                          '$.OriginalValuesJson'                      ),                      src.[value]                  )          FROM OPENJSON(@RowsJson) AS src;            IF NOT EXISTS          (              SELECT 1              FROM @RowsStage          )              THROW 51008, 'The export snapshot does not contain rows.', 1;            /* ------------------------------------------------------------------             3. Validaci�n del contenido             ------------------------------------------------------------------ */            IF EXISTS          (              SELECT 1              FROM @RowsStage              WHERE WorkItemId IS NULL                 OR WorkItemId <= 0                 OR RowChecksum IS NULL                 OR LEN(RowChecksum) <> 64                 OR RowChecksum LIKE '%[^0-9A-F]%'                 OR OriginalValuesJson IS NULL                 OR ISJSON(OriginalValuesJson) <> 1          )              THROW 51009, 'One or more export rows contain invalid identifiers, checksums or JSON.', 1;            IF EXISTS          (              SELECT                  WorkItemId              FROM @RowsStage              GROUP BY                  WorkItemId              HAVING COUNT(*) > 1          )              THROW 51013, 'The export snapshot contains duplicate PunchId values.', 1;            IF EXISTS          (              SELECT 1              FROM @RowsStage              WHERE SourceProjectId IS NULL                 OR SourceProjectId <> @ProjectId                 OR SourceExportLogId IS NULL                 OR SourceExportLogId <> @PunchExportLogId          )              THROW 51010, 'An export row does not match the batch project or export log.', 1;            /* ------------------------------------------------------------------             4. Conjunto validado             ------------------------------------------------------------------ */            DECLARE @Rows TABLE          (              WorkItemId          bigint          NOT NULL,              RowChecksum         char(64)        NOT NULL,              OriginalValuesJson  nvarchar(max)   NOT NULL,                PRIMARY KEY              (                  WorkItemId              )          );            INSERT INTO @Rows          (              WorkItemId,              RowChecksum,              OriginalValuesJson          )          SELECT              WorkItemId,              CONVERT(char(64), RowChecksum),              OriginalValuesJson          FROM @RowsStage;            DECLARE @RowCount int =          (              SELECT COUNT(*)              FROM @Rows          );            DECLARE @EffectiveExpiresAtUtc datetime2(3) =              COALESCE              (                  @ExpiresAtUtc,                  DATEADD                  (                      day,                      30,                      CONVERT(datetime2(3), SYSUTCDATETIME())                  )              );            DECLARE @ExportBatchId uniqueidentifier;          DECLARE @ExistingStatus varchar(20);            /* ------------------------------------------------------------------             5. Registro transaccional e idempotente             ------------------------------------------------------------------ */            BEGIN TRANSACTION;            SELECT              @ExportBatchId = ExportBatchId,              @ExistingStatus = Status          FROM [warroom].[ExportBatch] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)          WHERE PunchExportLogId = @PunchExportLogId;            /* ------------------------------------------------------------------             5.1. El snapshot ya existe             ------------------------------------------------------------------ */            IF @ExportBatchId IS NOT NULL          BEGIN              IF NOT EXISTS              (                  SELECT 1                  FROM [warroom].[ExportBatch]                  WHERE ExportBatchId = @ExportBatchId                    AND PunchExportLogId = @PunchExportLogId                    AND ProjectId = @ProjectId                    AND TemplateId = @TemplateId                    AND ExportType = @ExportType                    AND [RowCount] = @RowCount                    AND AllowedColumnsJson = @AllowedColumnsJson                    AND Status IN                    (                        'CREATED',                        'READY'                    )              )                  THROW 51011, 'The export batch already exists with different immutable data.', 1;                IF              (                  SELECT COUNT(*)                  FROM [warroom].[ExportBatchRow]                  WHERE ExportBatchId = @ExportBatchId              ) <> @RowCount                  THROW 51012, 'The existing export batch row count is inconsistent.', 1;                COMMIT TRANSACTION;                SELECT                  Success =                      CAST(1 AS bit),                    ExportBatchId =                      @ExportBatchId,                    PunchExportLogId =                      @PunchExportLogId,                    Status =                      @ExistingStatus,                    [RowCount] =                      @RowCount,                    WasAlreadyRegistered =                      CAST(1 AS bit);                RETURN;          END;            /* ------------------------------------------------------------------             5.2. Crear nuevo snapshot             ------------------------------------------------------------------ */            SET @ExportBatchId = NEWID();            INSERT INTO [warroom].[ExportBatch]          (              ExportBatchId,              PunchExportLogId,              ProjectId,              TemplateId,              ExportType,              CreatedBy,              CreatedAtUtc,              ExpiresAtUtc,              Status,              FileName,              [RowCount],              AllowedColumnsJson          )          VALUES          (              @ExportBatchId,              @PunchExportLogId,              @ProjectId,              @TemplateId,              @ExportType,              @CreatedBy,              CONVERT(datetime2(3), SYSUTCDATETIME()),              @EffectiveExpiresAtUtc,              'CREATED',              @FileName,              @RowCount,              @AllowedColumnsJson          );            INSERT INTO [warroom].[ExportBatchRow]          (              ExportBatchId,              WorkItemId,              OriginalValuesJson,              RowChecksum          )          SELECT              ExportBatchId =                  @ExportBatchId,                WorkItemId =                  r.WorkItemId,                OriginalValuesJson =                  r.OriginalValuesJson,                RowChecksum =                  r.RowChecksum          FROM @Rows AS r;            COMMIT TRANSACTION;            SELECT              Success =                  CAST(1 AS bit),                ExportBatchId =                  @ExportBatchId,                PunchExportLogId =                  @PunchExportLogId,                Status =                  CAST('CREATED' AS varchar(20)),                [RowCount] =                  @RowCount,                WasAlreadyRegistered =                  CAST(0 AS bit);      END TRY      BEGIN CATCH          IF XACT_STATE() <> 0              ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;            THROW;      END CATCH;  END;    GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO    CREATE PROCEDURE [warroom].[usp_ReportNode_Upsert]  (      @ProjectId     BIGINT,      @NodeId        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,   -- NULL = create      @LevelNo       TINYINT,      @ParentNodeId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,      @DisplayName   NVARCHAR(200),      @Description   NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,      @SqlKey        NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,      @GridKey       NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,      @SortOrder     INT = 0,      @IsActive      BIT = 1,      @Username      NVARCHAR(128) = NULL  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;      SET XACT_ABORT ON;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 1) NORMALIZACIÓN BÁSICA      -------------------------------------------------------------------      SET @DisplayName = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DisplayName)), '');      SET @Description = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Description)), '');      SET @SqlKey      = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SqlKey)), '');      SET @GridKey     = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@GridKey)), '');        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 2) VALIDACIONES DE ENTRADA      -------------------------------------------------------------------      IF @LevelNo NOT IN (1,2,3)          THROW 50001, 'LevelNo must be 1,2,3.', 1;        IF @DisplayName IS NULL          THROW 50011, 'DisplayName is required.', 1;        IF @LevelNo = 1 AND @ParentNodeId IS NOT NULL          THROW 50002, 'Level 1 cannot have ParentNodeId.', 1;        IF @LevelNo IN (2,3) AND @ParentNodeId IS NULL          THROW 50003, 'Level 2/3 require ParentNodeId.', 1;        IF @LevelNo <> 3 AND (@SqlKey IS NOT NULL OR @GridKey IS NOT NULL)          THROW 50004, 'SqlKey/GridKey only allowed for level 3.', 1;        IF @LevelNo = 3 AND (@SqlKey IS NULL OR @GridKey IS NULL)          THROW 50005, 'Level 3 requires SqlKey and GridKey.', 1;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 3) VALIDACIÓN DE NODO EXISTENTE SI ES UPDATE      -------------------------------------------------------------------      IF @NodeId IS NOT NULL      BEGIN          IF NOT EXISTS          (              SELECT 1              FROM warroom.ReportNode n              WHERE n.NodeId = @NodeId                AND n.ProjectId = @ProjectId          )              THROW 50012, 'NodeId not found for this ProjectId.', 1;      END        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 4) VALIDACIÓN DE PADRE      -------------------------------------------------------------------      IF @ParentNodeId IS NOT NULL      BEGIN          IF NOT EXISTS          (              SELECT 1              FROM warroom.ReportNode p              WHERE p.NodeId = @ParentNodeId                AND p.ProjectId = @ProjectId                AND p.IsActive = 1          )              THROW 50006, 'ParentNodeId not found for this ProjectId.', 1;            IF EXISTS          (              SELECT 1              FROM warroom.ReportNode p              WHERE p.NodeId = @ParentNodeId                AND p.ProjectId = @ProjectId                AND p.LevelNo <> @LevelNo - 1          )              THROW 50007, 'Parent level mismatch.', 1;            IF @NodeId IS NOT NULL AND @ParentNodeId = @NodeId              THROW 50013, 'A node cannot be its own parent.', 1;      END        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 5) VALIDACIONES DE DUPLICIDAD FUNCIONAL      --    Ojo: esto no sustituye índices únicos. Los complementa.      -------------------------------------------------------------------        -- 5.1) Mismo DisplayName bajo mismo padre / proyecto / nivel (activos)      IF EXISTS      (          SELECT 1          FROM warroom.ReportNode n          WHERE n.ProjectId = @ProjectId            AND n.IsActive = 1            AND n.LevelNo = @LevelNo            AND            (                (n.ParentNodeId = @ParentNodeId)                OR                (n.ParentNodeId IS NULL AND @ParentNodeId IS NULL)            )            AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.DisplayName))) = UPPER(@DisplayName)            AND (@NodeId IS NULL OR n.NodeId <> @NodeId)      )          THROW 50008, 'Duplicate DisplayName under same parent.', 1;        -- 5.2) SqlKey única por proyecto para nivel 3 activos      IF @LevelNo = 3         AND EXISTS      (          SELECT 1          FROM warroom.ReportNode n          WHERE n.ProjectId = @ProjectId            AND n.IsActive = 1            AND n.LevelNo = 3            AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.SqlKey))) = UPPER(@SqlKey)            AND (@NodeId IS NULL OR n.NodeId <> @NodeId)      )          THROW 50009, 'Duplicate SqlKey in project.', 1;        -- 5.3) GridKey única por proyecto para nivel 3 activos      IF @LevelNo = 3         AND EXISTS      (          SELECT 1          FROM warroom.ReportNode n          WHERE n.ProjectId = @ProjectId            AND n.IsActive = 1            AND n.LevelNo = 3            AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.GridKey))) = UPPER(@GridKey)            AND (@NodeId IS NULL OR n.NodeId <> @NodeId)      )          THROW 50010, 'Duplicate GridKey in project.', 1;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 6) UPSERT      -------------------------------------------------------------------      BEGIN TRAN;        IF @NodeId IS NULL      BEGIN          DECLARE @Out TABLE (NodeId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);            INSERT INTO warroom.ReportNode          (              ProjectId,              LevelNo,              ParentNodeId,              DisplayName,              Description,              SqlKey,              GridKey,              SortOrder,              IsActive,              CreatedBy          )          OUTPUT inserted.NodeId INTO @Out(NodeId)          VALUES          (              @ProjectId,              @LevelNo,              @ParentNodeId,              @DisplayName,              @Description,              CASE WHEN @LevelNo = 3 THEN @SqlKey  ELSE NULL END,              CASE WHEN @LevelNo = 3 THEN @GridKey ELSE NULL END,              @SortOrder,              @IsActive,              @Username          );            COMMIT TRAN;            SELECT NodeId          FROM @Out;            RETURN;      END        UPDATE warroom.ReportNode      SET          LevelNo      = @LevelNo,          ParentNodeId = @ParentNodeId,          DisplayName  = @DisplayName,          Description  = @Description,          SqlKey       = CASE WHEN @LevelNo = 3 THEN @SqlKey  ELSE NULL END,          GridKey      = CASE WHEN @LevelNo = 3 THEN @GridKey ELSE NULL END,          SortOrder    = @SortOrder,          IsActive     = @IsActive,          ModifiedOn   = SYSUTCDATETIME(),          ModifiedBy   = @Username      WHERE NodeId = @NodeId        AND ProjectId = @ProjectId;        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0      BEGIN          ROLLBACK TRAN;          THROW 50014, 'Update failed. Node not found for this ProjectId.', 1;      END        COMMIT TRAN;        SELECT @NodeId AS NodeId;  END    GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO    CREATE PROCEDURE [warroom].[usp_ReportTasks_FromConfig]  (      @ProjectId      BIGINT,      @SubsystemCode  NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,      @OnlyActive     BIT = 1,      @SaveTaskScope  BIT = 0  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;      SET XACT_ABORT ON;        DECLARE @Sub NVARCHAR(255) = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SubsystemCode)), '');      DECLARE @VersionId BIGINT;        SELECT TOP 1          @VersionId = v.VersionId      FROM warroom.ReportConfigVersion v      WHERE v.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND v.Status = 'Published'      ORDER BY v.VersionNo DESC;        IF @VersionId IS NULL      BEGIN          RAISERROR('No published report configuration found for this project.', 16, 1);          RETURN;      END;        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TargetSubsystems;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #SubsystemElements;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ITScope;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #NeedTM;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TM;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #NeedE;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #E;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #NeedF;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #F;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #NeedP;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #P;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #M;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MResolved;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TaskResolved;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CfgTaskAgg;      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #DoneStatuses;        CREATE TABLE #DoneStatuses      (          StatusId INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY      );        INSERT INTO #DoneStatuses(StatusId)      SELECT DISTINCT ds.StatusId      FROM warroom.DoneStatusSnapshot ds      WHERE ds.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND ds.VersionId = @VersionId        AND ds.IsDone = 1        AND ds.IsActive = 1        AND ds.StatusId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE TABLE #TargetSubsystems      (          SubsystemCode NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY      );        IF @Sub IS NULL      BEGIN          INSERT INTO #TargetSubsystems(SubsystemCode)          SELECT DISTINCT ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE          FROM dbo.Elements_Default ed          WHERE ed.ProjectId = @ProjectId            AND ed.LevelName = 'Subsystem'            AND ed.Active = 1            AND ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE IS NOT NULL;      END      ELSE      BEGIN          INSERT INTO #TargetSubsystems(SubsystemCode)          VALUES (@Sub);      END;        CREATE TABLE #SubsystemElements      (          ElementId     INT NOT NULL,          SubsystemCode NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL      );        INSERT INTO #SubsystemElements(ElementId, SubsystemCode)      SELECT          ed.ELEMENT_ID,          ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE      FROM dbo.Elements_Default ed      INNER JOIN #TargetSubsystems s          ON s.SubsystemCode = ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE      WHERE ed.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND ed.Active = 1        AND ed.ELEMENT_ID IS NOT NULL        AND ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE IS NOT NULL;        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_SubsystemElements_ElementId          ON #SubsystemElements(ElementId);        CREATE INDEX IX_SubsystemElements_SubsystemCode          ON #SubsystemElements(SubsystemCode);        CREATE TABLE #ITScope      (          InspectionTaskId INT NOT NULL,          SubsystemCode    NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,          TaskMatrixItemId INT NOT NULL,          ElementId        INT NULL,          StatusVal        INT NULL      );        INSERT INTO #ITScope      (          InspectionTaskId,          SubsystemCode,          TaskMatrixItemId,          ElementId,          StatusVal      )      SELECT          it.Id,          se.SubsystemCode,          it.TaskMatrixItemId,          it.ElementId,          it.[Status]      FROM dbo.InspectionTasks it      INNER JOIN #SubsystemElements se          ON se.ElementId = it.ElementId      WHERE it.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND it.TaskMatrixItemId IS NOT NULL        AND (@OnlyActive = 0 OR it.Active = 1);        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ITScope_TaskId          ON #ITScope(InspectionTaskId);        CREATE INDEX IX_ITScope_TaskMatrixItemId          ON #ITScope(TaskMatrixItemId);        CREATE INDEX IX_ITScope_ElementId          ON #ITScope(ElementId)          WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE INDEX IX_ITScope_SubsystemCode          ON #ITScope(SubsystemCode);        SELECT DISTINCT          TaskMatrixItemId      INTO #NeedTM      FROM #ITScope;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedTM_TaskMatrixItemId          ON #NeedTM(TaskMatrixItemId);        SELECT          tm.Id,          tm.ProjectId,          tm.ElementTypeId,          tm.FormId,          tm.MasterTask,          tm.Description,          tm.DisciplineId,          tm.Sct,          tm.ElementId      INTO #TM      FROM dbo.TaskMatrices tm      INNER JOIN #NeedTM ntm          ON ntm.TaskMatrixItemId = tm.Id      WHERE tm.ProjectId = @ProjectId;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TM_Id          ON #TM(Id);        CREATE INDEX IX_TM_ElementId          ON #TM(ElementId)          WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE INDEX IX_TM_FormId          ON #TM(FormId)          WHERE FormId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT DISTINCT ElementId      INTO #NeedE      FROM #TM      WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedE_ElementId          ON #NeedE(ElementId);        SELECT          e.Id                  AS ELEMENT_ID,          e.TypeId              AS ElementTypeId,          nl.Name               AS LevelName,          CAST(e.Active AS BIT) AS Active      INTO #E      FROM dbo.Elements e      INNER JOIN #NeedE ne          ON ne.ElementId = e.Id      LEFT JOIN dbo.NodeLevels nl          ON nl.Id = e.NodeLevelId      WHERE e.ProjectId = @ProjectId;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_E_EID          ON #E(ELEMENT_ID);        CREATE INDEX IX_E_TypeId          ON #E(ElementTypeId)          WHERE ElementTypeId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT DISTINCT FormId      INTO #NeedF      FROM #TM      WHERE FormId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedF_FormId          ON #NeedF(FormId);        SELECT          f.Id          AS FormId,          f.ProjectId,          f.Name        AS FormName,          f.Description AS FormDescription,          f.PhaseId      INTO #F      FROM dbo.Forms f      INNER JOIN #NeedF nf          ON nf.FormId = f.Id      WHERE f.ProjectId = @ProjectId;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_F_FormId          ON #F(FormId);        CREATE INDEX IX_F_PhaseId          ON #F(PhaseId)          WHERE PhaseId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT DISTINCT PhaseId      INTO #NeedP      FROM #F      WHERE PhaseId IS NOT NULL;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NeedP_PhaseId          ON #NeedP(PhaseId);        SELECT          p.Id   AS PhaseId,          p.Name AS PhaseName      INTO #P      FROM dbo.Phases p      INNER JOIN #NeedP np          ON np.PhaseId = p.Id;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_P_PhaseId          ON #P(PhaseId);        SELECT          tm.Id,            ResolutionSource =              CASE                  WHEN tm.ElementId IS NOT NULL AND e.ELEMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ELEMENT'                  ELSE 'MATRIX'              END,            tm.ElementId,            GroupKey =              CONVERT(CHAR(64),                  HASHBYTES('SHA2_256',                      CONCAT(                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(COALESCE(d_e.Name, d_tm.Name), '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(COALESCE(e.LevelName, nl_tm.Name), '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(p.PhaseName, '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(f.FormName, '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(f.FormDescription, '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(tm.Sct AS VARCHAR(20)), '')))), '|',                          UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(tm.MasterTask AS VARCHAR(20)), ''))))                      )                  ), 2              )      INTO #M      FROM #TM tm      LEFT JOIN #F f          ON f.FormId = tm.FormId      LEFT JOIN #P p          ON p.PhaseId = f.PhaseId        LEFT JOIN #E e          ON e.ELEMENT_ID = tm.ElementId      LEFT JOIN dbo.ElementTypes et_e          ON et_e.Id = e.ElementTypeId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Disciplines d_e          ON d_e.Id = et_e.DisciplineId        LEFT JOIN dbo.ElementTypes et_tm          ON et_tm.Id = tm.ElementTypeId      LEFT JOIN dbo.NodeLevels nl_tm          ON nl_tm.Id = et_tm.NodeLevelId      LEFT JOIN dbo.Disciplines d_tm          ON d_tm.Id = tm.DisciplineId      WHERE          tm.ElementId IS NULL          OR e.Active = 1;        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_M_Id          ON #M(Id);        CREATE INDEX IX_M_GroupKey          ON #M(GroupKey);        CREATE INDEX IX_M_ElementId_RS          ON #M(ElementId, ResolutionSource)          WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT          m.Id,          m.GroupKey,          m.ResolutionSource,          m.ElementId,            n1.NodeId      AS L1NodeId,          n1.DisplayName AS L1DisplayName,          n1.SortOrder   AS L1SortOrder,            n2.NodeId      AS L2NodeId,          n2.DisplayName AS L2DisplayName,          n2.SortOrder   AS L2SortOrder,            n3.NodeId      AS L3NodeId,          n3.DisplayName AS L3DisplayName,          n3.SqlKey      AS L3SqlKey,          n3.GridKey     AS L3GridKey,          n3.SortOrder   AS L3SortOrder      INTO #MResolved      FROM #M m      INNER JOIN warroom.ReportAssignmentSnapshot ra          ON ra.ProjectId = @ProjectId         AND ra.VersionId = @VersionId         AND ra.GroupKey = m.GroupKey         AND ra.IsActive = 1      INNER JOIN warroom.ReportNodeSnapshot n3          ON n3.VersionId = ra.VersionId         AND n3.ProjectId = ra.ProjectId         AND n3.NodeId = ra.NodeId         AND n3.LevelNo = 3         AND n3.IsActive = 1      INNER JOIN warroom.ReportNodeSnapshot n2          ON n2.VersionId = n3.VersionId         AND n2.ProjectId = n3.ProjectId         AND n2.NodeId = n3.ParentNodeId         AND n2.LevelNo = 2         AND n2.IsActive = 1      INNER JOIN warroom.ReportNodeSnapshot n1          ON n1.VersionId = n2.VersionId         AND n1.ProjectId = n2.ProjectId         AND n1.NodeId = n2.ParentNodeId         AND n1.LevelNo = 1         AND n1.IsActive = 1;        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_MResolved_Id          ON #MResolved(Id);        CREATE INDEX IX_MResolved_ElementId          ON #MResolved(ElementId)          WHERE ElementId IS NOT NULL;        SELECT          it.InspectionTaskId,          it.SubsystemCode,          it.StatusVal,            mr.GroupKey,            mr.L1NodeId,          mr.L1DisplayName,          mr.L1SortOrder,            mr.L2NodeId,          mr.L2DisplayName,          mr.L2SortOrder,            mr.L3NodeId,          mr.L3DisplayName,          mr.L3SqlKey,          mr.L3GridKey,          mr.L3SortOrder      INTO #TaskResolved      FROM #ITScope it      INNER JOIN #MResolved mr          ON mr.Id = it.TaskMatrixItemId         AND         (              mr.ResolutionSource = 'MATRIX'              OR              (                  mr.ResolutionSource = 'ELEMENT'                  AND mr.ElementId = it.ElementId              )         );        CREATE INDEX IX_TaskResolved_Group          ON #TaskResolved          (              SubsystemCode,              L1SortOrder,              L2SortOrder,              L3SortOrder,              L3DisplayName          );        IF @SaveTaskScope = 1      BEGIN          DELETE FROM warroom.OverviewSnapshotTaskScope          WHERE ProjectId = @ProjectId;            INSERT INTO warroom.OverviewSnapshotTaskScope          (              ProjectId,              InspectionTaskId,              L3NodeId,              GroupKey          )          SELECT DISTINCT              @ProjectId,              tr.InspectionTaskId,              tr.L3NodeId,              tr.GroupKey          FROM #TaskResolved tr          WHERE tr.L3NodeId IS NOT NULL;            INSERT INTO warroom.OverviewSnapshotTaskScope          (              ProjectId,              InspectionTaskId,              L3NodeId,              GroupKey          )          SELECT              @ProjectId,              tr.InspectionTaskId,              NULL,              MIN(tr.GroupKey)          FROM #TaskResolved tr          GROUP BY tr.InspectionTaskId;      END;        SELECT          ProjectLevel   = CAST('SUBSYSTEM' AS VARCHAR(100)),          ProjectElement = tr.SubsystemCode,            tr.L1NodeId,          tr.L1DisplayName,          tr.L1SortOrder,            tr.L2NodeId,          tr.L2DisplayName,          tr.L2SortOrder,            tr.L3NodeId,          tr.L3DisplayName,          tr.L3SqlKey,          tr.L3GridKey,          tr.L3SortOrder,            TOTAL = COUNT_BIG(1),            DONE = SUM(              CASE                  WHEN ds.StatusId IS NOT NULL THEN 1                  ELSE 0              END          ),            REMAIN = SUM(              CASE                  WHEN ds.StatusId IS NULL THEN 1                  ELSE 0              END          )      INTO #CfgTaskAgg      FROM #TaskResolved tr      LEFT JOIN #DoneStatuses ds          ON ds.StatusId = tr.StatusVal      GROUP BY          tr.SubsystemCode,          tr.L1NodeId,          tr.L1DisplayName,          tr.L1SortOrder,          tr.L2NodeId,          tr.L2DisplayName,          tr.L2SortOrder,          tr.L3NodeId,          tr.L3DisplayName,          tr.L3SqlKey,          tr.L3GridKey,          tr.L3SortOrder;        SELECT          ProjectLevel,          ProjectElement,            L1NodeId,          L1DisplayName,          L1SortOrder,            L2NodeId,          L2DisplayName,          L2SortOrder,            L3NodeId,          L3DisplayName,          L3SqlKey,          L3GridKey,          L3SortOrder,            TOTAL,          DONE,          REMAIN      FROM #CfgTaskAgg      ORDER BY          ProjectElement,          L1SortOrder,          L2SortOrder,          L3SortOrder,          L3DisplayName;  END    GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO      CREATE   PROCEDURE warroom.usp_Security_GetMyPermissions  (      @Email NVARCHAR(255),      @ProjectId BIGINT  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;        DECLARE @LoginEmail NVARCHAR(255) = LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Email)));        SELECT DISTINCT          p.PermissionKey,          p.PermissionName,          p.ModuleKey,          p.SortOrder      FROM warroom.Users u      INNER JOIN warroom.UserProjectRoles upr          ON upr.UserId = u.UserId         AND upr.IsActive = 1      INNER JOIN warroom.Roles r          ON r.RoleId = upr.RoleId         AND r.IsActive = 1      INNER JOIN warroom.RolePermissions rp          ON rp.RoleId = r.RoleId         AND rp.IsActive = 1      INNER JOIN warroom.Permissions p          ON p.PermissionId = rp.PermissionId         AND p.IsActive = 1      WHERE LOWER(u.LoginEmail) = @LoginEmail        AND u.IsActive = 1        AND upr.ProjectId = @ProjectId      ORDER BY p.SortOrder;  END;    GO

   ------------------------------------------------------------      -- 1) Lista de ElementId realmente usados (reduce #E)      ------------------------------------------------------------      IF   INTO #E   FROM dbo.Elements e   INNER JOIN #NeedE ne    ON ne.ElementId = e.Id   LEFT JOIN dbo.NodeLevels nl    ON nl.Id = e.NodeLevelId   LEFT JOIN dbo.ElementTypes et    ON et.Id = e.TypeId   WHERE    e.ProjectId = @ProjectId;     CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_E_EID ON #E(ELEMENT_ID);   CREATE INDEX IX_E_TypeCode ON #E(TYPE_CODE) WHERE TYPE_CODE IS NOT NULL;      ------------------------------------------------------------      -- 3) Stage Forms SOLO para FormId necesarios (external)      ------------------------------------------------------------      IF      CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_F_FormId ON #F(FormId);      CREATE INDEX IX_F_PhaseId ON #F(PhaseId) WHERE PhaseId IS NOT NULL; tm.ManHours,          tm.ElementClassId,          tm.ElementId,          tm.CreatedDate,          tm.CpTask,          tm.CPId,          tm.DeletedRemarks,            -- nuevos campos pedidos          f.FormName,          f.FormDescription,          p.PhaseName,            -- campos calculados ya existentes          ResolutionSource =              CASE                  WHEN tm.ElementId IS NOT NULL AND e.ELEMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ELEMENT'                  ELSE 'MATRIX'              END,            ElementLevel =              COALESCE(e.LevelName, nl_tm.Name),            ElementType =              COALESCE(et_e.Name, et_tm.Name),            ElementClass =              COALESCE(e.CLASS_CODE, et_e.Code, et_tm.Code),            ElementDiscipline =              COALESCE(d_e.Name, d_tm.Name),  ON d_e.Id = et_e.DisciplineId        -- Rama MATRIX      LEFT JOIN ElementTypes et_tm          ON et_tm.Id = tm.ElementTypeId      LEFT JOIN NodeLevels nl_tm          ON nl_tm.Id = et_tm.NodeLevelId SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO      CREATE   PROCEDURE warroom.usp_UpsertPunchCustom  (      @ProjectId BIGINT,      @PunchId INT,        @CustomFlag1 bit = NULL,      @CustomText1 nvarchar(1000) = NULL,      @CustomDate1 date = NULL,      @CustomNumber1 decimal(18,2) = NULL,      @CustomJson nvarchar(max) = NULL,        @UserEmail nvarchar(256)  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;        SET @CustomText1 = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CustomText1)), '');      SET @CustomJson  = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CustomJson)), '');      IF @CustomJson IS NULL SET @CustomJson = N'{}';        MERGE warroom.PunchCustom AS tgt      USING (SELECT @ProjectId AS ProjectId, @PunchId AS PunchId) src         ON tgt.ProjectId = src.ProjectId AND tgt.PunchId = src.PunchId      WHEN MATCHED THEN          UPDATE SET              CustomFlag1 = COALESCE(@CustomFlag1, tgt.CustomFlag1),              CustomText1 = COALESCE(@CustomText1, tgt.CustomText1),              CustomDate1 = COALESCE(@CustomDate1, tgt.CustomDate1),              CustomNumber1 = COALESCE(@CustomNumber1, tgt.CustomNumber1),              CustomJson = COALESCE(@CustomJson, tgt.CustomJson),              LastUpdatedByEmail = @UserEmail,              LastUpdatedOn = SYSUTCDATETIME()      WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN          INSERT (PunchId, ProjectId, CustomFlag1, CustomText1, CustomDate1, CustomNumber1, CustomJson, LastUpdatedByEmail, LastUpdatedOn)          VALUES (@PunchId, @ProjectId, ISNULL(@CustomFlag1,0), @CustomText1, @CustomDate1, @CustomNumber1, @CustomJson, @UserEmail, SYSUTCDATETIME());        SELECT 1 AS Saved;  END;    GO
