SET ANSI_NULLS ON;  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;  GO    CREATE PROCEDURE [warroom].[usp_WarRoomReport_GetPage]  (      @ProjectId       BIGINT,      @SearchSubsystem NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,      @PageNumber      INT = 1,      @PageSize        INT = 10  )  AS  BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;      SET XACT_ABORT ON;     DECLARE @T0 DATETIME2 = SYSDATETIME();  DECLARE @T1 DATETIME2;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 0) Normalización de parámetros      -------------------------------------------------------------------      IF @PageNumber < 1 SET @PageNumber = 1;      IF @PageSize   < 1 SET @PageSize   = 10;        DECLARE @Search NVARCHAR(50) = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SearchSubsystem)), '');        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- Limpieza previa      -------------------------------------------------------------------      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Subsystems')   IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Subsystems;      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TaskAgg')      IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TaskAgg;      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#PunchAgg')     IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #PunchAgg;      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#OutRaw')       IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #OutRaw;      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Out')          IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Out;      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Page')         IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Page;      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#HdrExpanded')  IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #HdrExpanded;      IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Metrics')      IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Metrics;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 1) Subsistemas objetivo      -------------------------------------------------------------------      CREATE TABLE #Subsystems      (          SubsystemCode NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY      );        INSERT INTO #Subsystems(SubsystemCode)      SELECT DISTINCT CAST(ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE AS NVARCHAR(255))      FROM dbo.Elements_Default ed      WHERE ed.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND ed.LevelName = 'Subsystem'        AND ed.Active = 1        AND ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE IS NOT NULL        AND (@Search IS NULL OR ed.SUBSYSTEM_CODE LIKE '%' + @Search + '%');        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 2) Tasks agregadas desde configuración      -------------------------------------------------------------------      CREATE TABLE #TaskAgg      (          ProjectLevel   VARCHAR(100)     NOT NULL,          ProjectElement NVARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL,            L1NodeId       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,          L1DisplayName  NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          L1SortOrder    INT              NOT NULL,            L2NodeId       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,          L2DisplayName  NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          L2SortOrder    INT              NOT NULL,            L3NodeId       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,          L3DisplayName  NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          L3SqlKey       NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          L3GridKey      NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          L3SortOrder    INT              NOT NULL,            TOTAL          BIGINT           NOT NULL,          DONE           BIGINT           NOT NULL,          REMAIN         BIGINT           NOT NULL      );        INSERT INTO #TaskAgg      EXEC warroom.usp_ReportTasks_FromConfig           @ProjectId     = @ProjectId,           @SubsystemCode = NULL,           @OnlyActive    = 1;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 2.1) Filtrar TaskAgg por subsistemas objetivo      -------------------------------------------------------------------      DELETE t      FROM #TaskAgg t      WHERE NOT EXISTS      (          SELECT 1          FROM #Subsystems s          WHERE s.SubsystemCode = t.ProjectElement      );     SET @T1 = SYSDATETIME();    SELECT      Step = 'TaskAgg',      Ms = DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND,@T0,@T1);    SET @T0 = SYSDATETIME();        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 3) Punches      --     Se mantienen en la salida numérica, pero no se incorporan a la      --     jerarquía de 4 niveles de TASKS.      -------------------------------------------------------------------      SELECT          ProjectLevel   = CAST('SUBSYSTEM' AS VARCHAR(100)),          ProjectElement = CAST(p.SubSystemCode AS NVARCHAR(255)),          CategoryCode   = CAST(p.CategoryCode AS NVARCHAR(20)),          Q_T  = COUNT_BIG(1),          Q_O  = SUM(CASE WHEN p.StatusCode = 'OPEN'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),          Q_CL = SUM(CASE WHEN p.StatusCode = 'CLEARED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),          Q_CS = SUM(CASE WHEN p.StatusCode = 'CLOSED'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)      INTO #PunchAgg      FROM dbo.wap_PunchPaged p      INNER JOIN #Subsystems s          ON s.SubsystemCode = p.SubSystemCode      WHERE p.ProjectId = @ProjectId        AND p.StatusCode IS NOT NULL        AND p.CategoryCode IS NOT NULL      GROUP BY p.SubSystemCode, p.CategoryCode;       SET @T1 = SYSDATETIME();    SELECT      Step = 'PunchAgg',      Ms = DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND,@T0,@T1);    SET @T0 = SYSDATETIME();        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 4) Salida plana raw      -------------------------------------------------------------------      CREATE TABLE #OutRaw      (          ProjectLevel   VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,          ProjectElement NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,          JobLabel       VARCHAR(300)  NOT NULL,          Qty            BIGINT        NOT NULL      );        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 4.1) TASKS      -------------------------------------------------------------------      INSERT INTO #OutRaw(ProjectLevel, ProjectElement, JobLabel, Qty)      SELECT ProjectLevel, ProjectElement, CONCAT('TASKS_', L3SqlKey, '_TOTAL'), TOTAL      FROM #TaskAgg      UNION ALL      SELECT ProjectLevel, ProjectElement, CONCAT('TASKS_', L3SqlKey, '_DONE'), DONE      FROM #TaskAgg      UNION ALL      SELECT ProjectLevel, ProjectElement, CONCAT('TASKS_', L3SqlKey, '_REMAINING'), REMAIN      FROM #TaskAgg;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 4.2) PUNCHES      -------------------------------------------------------------------      INSERT INTO #OutRaw(ProjectLevel, ProjectElement, JobLabel, Qty)      SELECT ProjectLevel, ProjectElement, CONCAT('PUNCHS_', CategoryCode, '_TOTAL'), Q_T      FROM #PunchAgg      UNION ALL      SELECT ProjectLevel, ProjectElement, CONCAT('PUNCHS_', CategoryCode, '_OPEN'), Q_O      FROM #PunchAgg      UNION ALL      SELECT ProjectLevel, ProjectElement, CONCAT('PUNCHS_', CategoryCode, '_CLEARED'), Q_CL      FROM #PunchAgg      UNION ALL      SELECT ProjectLevel, ProjectElement, CONCAT('PUNCHS_', CategoryCode, '_CLOSED'), Q_CS      FROM #PunchAgg;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 4.3) Compactar por si hubiera duplicados      -------------------------------------------------------------------      SELECT          ProjectLevel,          ProjectElement,          JobLabel,          Qty = SUM(Qty)      INTO #Out      FROM #OutRaw      WHERE ProjectLevel = 'SUBSYSTEM'        AND ProjectElement IS NOT NULL      GROUP BY          ProjectLevel,          ProjectElement,          JobLabel;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 5) TotalCount de subsystems      -------------------------------------------------------------------      DECLARE @TotalCount INT;        ;WITH S AS      (          SELECT DISTINCT              SubsystemCode = CAST(ProjectElement AS NVARCHAR(50))          FROM #Out          WHERE ProjectLevel = 'SUBSYSTEM'            AND ProjectElement IS NOT NULL      )      SELECT @TotalCount = COUNT(1)      FROM S;        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 6) Página de subsystems      -------------------------------------------------------------------      ;WITH S AS      (          SELECT DISTINCT              SubsystemCode = CAST(ProjectElement AS NVARCHAR(50))          FROM #Out          WHERE ProjectLevel = 'SUBSYSTEM'            AND ProjectElement IS NOT NULL      ),      N AS      (          SELECT              SubsystemCode,              RN = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SubsystemCode)          FROM S      )      SELECT          SubsystemCode      INTO #Page      FROM N      WHERE RN BETWEEN ((@PageNumber - 1) * @PageSize + 1)                  AND ( @PageNumber      * @PageSize);        -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 7) Header expandido REAL para 4 niveles      --      --    Cada L3 genera 3 columnas finales:      --      TOTAL / DONE / REMAINING      -------------------------------------------------------------------      CREATE TABLE #HdrExpanded      (          L1NodeId        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,          L1Label         NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          L1SortOrder     INT              NOT NULL,            L2NodeId        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,          L2Label         NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          L2SortOrder     INT              NOT NULL,            L3NodeId        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,          L3Label         NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          L3SortOrder     INT              NOT NULL,            MetricKey       NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          MetricSqlKey    NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,          MetricLabel     NVARCHAR(100)    NOT NULL,          MetricSortOrder INT              NOT NULL      );        INSERT INTO #HdrExpanded      (          L1NodeId, L1Label, L1SortOrder,          L2NodeId, L2Label, L2SortOrder,          L3NodeId, L3Label, L3SortOrder,          MetricKey, MetricSqlKey, MetricLabel, MetricSortOrder      )      SELECT DISTINCT          t.L1NodeId,          t.L1DisplayName,          ISNULL(t.L1SortOrder, 0),            t.L2NodeId,          t.L2DisplayName,          ISNULL(t.L2SortOrder, 0),            t.L3NodeId,          t.L3DisplayName,          ISNULL(t.L3SortOrder, 0),            CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.L3GridKey)), ''), t.L3SqlKey), '_TOTAL'),          CONCAT('TASKS_', t.L3SqlKey, '_TOTAL'),          'TOTAL',          1      FROM #TaskAgg t        UNION ALL        SELECT DISTINCT          t.L1NodeId,          t.L1DisplayName,          ISNULL(t.L1SortOrder, 0),            t.L2NodeId,          t.L2DisplayName,          ISNULL(t.L2SortOrder, 0),            t.L3NodeId,          t.L3DisplayName,          ISNULL(t.L3SortOrder, 0),            CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.L3GridKey)), ''), t.L3SqlKey), '_DONE'),          CONCAT('TASKS_', t.L3SqlKey, '_DONE'),          'DONE',          2      FROM #TaskAgg t        UNION ALL        SELECT DISTINCT          t.L1NodeId,          t.L1DisplayName,          ISNULL(t.L1SortOrder, 0),            t.L2NodeId,          t.L2DisplayName,          ISNULL(t.L2SortOrder, 0),            t.L3NodeId,          t.L3DisplayName,          ISNULL(t.L3SortOrder, 0),            CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.L3GridKey)), ''), t.L3SqlKey), '_REMAINING'),          CONCAT('TASKS_', t.L3SqlKey, '_REMAINING'),          'REMAINING',          3      FROM #TaskAgg t;                -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 8) Metrics para la página actual      --      --    Solo sacamos métricas cuya columna exista en el header expandido.      -------------------------------------------------------------------      SELECT          SubsystemCode = CAST(o.ProjectElement AS NVARCHAR(50)),          MetricKey     = h.MetricKey,          MetricValue   = o.Qty      INTO #Metrics      FROM #Out o      INNER JOIN #Page p          ON p.SubsystemCode = CAST(o.ProjectElement AS NVARCHAR(50))      INNER JOIN #HdrExpanded h          ON h.MetricSqlKey = CAST(o.JobLabel AS NVARCHAR(200));        SET @T1 = SYSDATETIME();    SELECT      Step = 'Metrics',      Ms = DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND,@T0,@T1);    SET @T0 = SYSDATETIME();      -------------------------------------------------------------------      -- 9) JSON final      -------------------------------------------------------------------     SET @T1 = SYSDATETIME();    SELECT      Step = 'JsonBuild',      Ms = DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND,@T0,@T1);              SELECT          SubsystemsJson =              ISNULL(                  (                      SELECT                          SubsystemCode                      FROM #Page                      ORDER BY SubsystemCode                      FOR JSON PATH                  ),                  '[]'              ),            HeadersJson =              ISNULL(                  (                      SELECT                          L1NodeId,                          L1Label,                          L1SortOrder,                            L2NodeId,                          L2Label,                          L2SortOrder,                            L3NodeId,                          L3Label,                          L3SortOrder,                            MetricKey,                          MetricSqlKey,                          MetricLabel,                          MetricSortOrder                      FROM #HdrExpanded                      ORDER BY                          L1SortOrder,                          L1Label,                          L2SortOrder,                          L2Label,                          L3SortOrder,                          L3Label,                          MetricSortOrder,                          MetricKey                      FOR JSON PATH                  ),                  '[]'              ),            MetricsJson =              ISNULL(                  (                      SELECT                          SubsystemCode,                          MetricKey,                          MetricValue                      FROM #Metrics                      ORDER BY                          SubsystemCode,                          MetricKey                      FOR JSON PATH                  ),                  '[]'              ),            TotalCount = ISNULL(@TotalCount, 0);
